"""Verify committed-location evidence, cleanup and documentation without native execution."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/public-docs-api/shardloom-local-repo')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REVIEW = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/cyclic-existence-2026-10-21'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def command(args):
    subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, check=True)


bridge = read(OUT / 'cyclic-existence-acceptance-853/package-metadata-bridge.json')
assert all(digest(ROOT / name) == value for name, value in bridge['source_hashes'].items())
for name in ('verify_acceptance.py', 'check_acceptance_verifier.py'):
    ast.parse((REVIEW / name).read_text())
    command([sys.executable, '-B', str(REVIEW / name), '--repository', str(ROOT),
             '--manifest', str(REVIEW / 'acceptance.json')])
command([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_v1_inclusion_scope.py',
         '--output', str(OUT / 'cyclic-existence-closeout-v1-scope-855.json')])
command(['git', 'diff', '--check'])
changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines()
assert changed and all(name.endswith('.md') for name in changed)
links = 0
for name in changed:
    diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--unified=0', '--', name], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    for line in diff.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('+') or line.startswith('+++'):
            continue
        for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', line):
            if target.startswith(('http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', '#')):
                continue
            path = target.split('#', 1)[0]
            assert (ROOT / name).parent.joinpath(path).exists(), (name, target)
            links += 1
summary = read(REVIEW / 'cleanup.json')
packed = (REVIEW / summary['packet']['file']).read_bytes()
assert len(packed) == summary['packet']['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest() == summary['packet']['sha256']
packet = json.loads(lzma.decompress(packed))
assert len(packet['members']) == summary['packet']['members']
for row in packet['members'].values():
    raw = row['text'].encode()
    assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == row['sha256']
plan = json.loads(packet['members']['cyclic-existence-retirement-plan-855.json']['text'])
receipt = json.loads(packet['members']['cyclic-existence-retirement-855.json']['text'])
assert summary['status'] == receipt['status'] == 'passed'
assert summary['retired_regular_files'] == receipt['retired_files'] == 35888
assert summary['retired_symlinks'] == sum(row['kind'] == 'symlink' for row in plan['members'].values()) == 3
assert receipt['completed'] == [row['path'] for row in plan['retire']]
assert all(not Path(path).exists() for path in receipt['completed'])
assert all(Path(path).is_file() for path in plan['retain'])
assert receipt['retained_identities_unchanged'] and not receipt['storage_limits_changed'] and receipt['archives_created'] == 0
assert all(digest(ROOT / name) == value for name, value in bridge['source_hashes'].items())
result = dict(status='passed', unchanged_frozen_source_files=len(bridge['source_hashes']),
              documentation_files=len(changed), added_local_links=links,
              portable_replay_after_payload_retirement=True, corruption_checks=10,
              cleanup_regular_files=35888, cleanup_symlinks=3,
              source_runtime_unchanged=True, native_execution_repeated=False,
              scope='Documentation, portable result replay, declared scope and exact cleanup only.')
with (OUT / 'cyclic-existence-closeout-855.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
